material.description: LAMPORT-trav-hud-client-LAMPORT-2 is partly fixed (published 7a06187101c2d81a23ae75fc79b14a4646c00169): the per-unit max survives a hud.js rebuild. The first-seen case remains. External fact: rust/crates/web/src/lib.rs at origin/main exports unit_hp (hit points only) and unit_hps; no max-hp accessor exists (origin awk for hp_max, max_hp and unit_hp* returned only lines 216 and 293; codesearch literal hp_max on the local checkout, dispatch 1792862262736-5384-decb96af105b782, returned no match). The sim keeps hp_max (rust/crates/sim/src/arrays.rs:63). Clearing action: a lane that owns rust/crates/web/src/lib.rs adds a unit max-hp export, then hud.js drawBars uses it instead of trackedMaxHp. blocked_by: LAMPORT-trav-hud-client-LAMPORT-2. Witness: a live damaged unit first seen at 40 of 100 hp draws a 40 percent bar.
material.subject: Blocked: the wasm exports no unit max hp, so a unit first seen damaged still draws a full bar
material.witness: Accessor Game::unit_max_hps (rust/crates/web/src/lib.rs, commit 24b486af) is on origin tip 9400c259: ci-status success and pages success at that sha. Witness is the ci-status dispatch from session verify-LAMPORT-2-blocker-drain-gui-hud-client-1. The JS side (hud.js drawBars reading unit_max_hps) is recorded on the LAMPORT-2 row for the HUD lane.

witness_request.note: Export landed at 24b486af (wasm: Game::unit_max_hps, Vec<i32> in unit_ids() order, read from the sim's hp_max accessor). The wasm side is done. The JS side is not in this change and belongs to the HUD lane (drain-hud-3): hud.js drawBars should read game.unit_max_hps() aligned to unit_ids() instead of trackedMaxHp. Witness held: ci for 24b486af is red on the pages first-draw timing job, see ci-pages-first-draw-red-on-24b486af-blocker-drain-wasm-hp-3.
